problems: serbian-despots: identity.wikipedia changed to 'Balšić noble family' and wikidata to null (Q878319 and 'Serbian Despotate' belong to moravian-serbia); the orchestrator should check the polities.csv link for this row.

kingdom-of-bosnia /ledger/4 records the 1391 loss of Kotor (and Dalmatian cities) to kingdom-of-hungary at confidence 1; the Đurađ II page has Đurađ II seizing Kotor after Tvrtko's death in March 1391, so the Kotor part of that event should have counterpart serbian-despots. The eu-18 Bosnia owner has to agree; serbian-despots keeps counterpart kingdom-of-bosnia for the 1391 gain and adds a 1392 loss of the Kotor lands to Radič Crnojević.

banate-of-bosnia /ledger/15 (1377 gain of Trebinje, Konavle and Dračevica) uses the free-text counterpart 'Djuradj I Balsic (Zeta)'; serbian-despots /ledger/2 is its mirror (loss in 1377 to banate-of-bosnia, confidence 3). The banate dossier's counterpart could read serbian-despots.

albanian-principalities (thin, not touched) lacks the mirror gains for the serbian-despots losses of 1386: Lezhë and the Drin area (Pal Dukagjini) and the Jonima lands between Durrës and the Drin. Its Durrës 1385 loss and gain (ledger 3 and 5) are now mirrored in serbian-despots.

republic-of-venice (eu-13) should mirror: Onogošt (Nikšić) 1386 from serbian-despots, Scutari 1396 with counterpart serbian-despots (now albanian-principalities), Ulcinj/Bar/Budva 1405, Bar 1412, Shkodër 1418 and Bar 1421.

Disagreements with the reviewer: the coast (Trebinje, Konavle, Dračevica) is dated 1377 from the Đurađ I Balšić page, not c.1378-1379; Kosovo 1378. The Đurađ II page puts Vuk Branković's taking of Peć and Prizren after Savra (1385-86), the two Balšić pages in the late 1370s; the dossier follows the latter and says so in the ledger note and in the notes file.
Fix 6 is partial: the Kotor counterpart could not be agreed with the Bosnia owner from here (see the Kotor problem above); the Kotor loss and the note are added.

Page budget for serbian-despots (5) is exceeded by two pages: Balšić noble family (the reviewer's pointer) and Đurađ I Balšić (needed to date the 1371-1378 gains and the 1377 coast loss). Cliopatria's 1375 shape carries from/to 1377 although the schema describes from/to as for new keyframes; the validator accepts it.
Not touched by this repair: despotate-of-dobruja, despotate-of-vidin (pass), principality-of-moldavia, albanian-principalities (thin).
